caption: The worked example drawn to scale: one 600 px container laid out with no gap, and again with a 30 px gap. The two gaps eat 60 px, so the items drop to 135, 270 and 135 px — and the middle item still stays exactly twice each side item.

spec.aria: A 600 px flex container is drawn twice: with no gap the items A, B and C take 150, 300 and 150 px; with a 30 px gap the two gaps take 60 px and the items become 135, 270 and 135 px.
